summary: test22221 exfiltrates host identifiers and polls attacker C2 during npm install
details: package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that run on `npm install`. The scripts invoke curl against a hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint at 54.37.234.136, sending installer-side reconnaissance data (whoami, hostname, current working directory, timestamp) as query-string parameters to http://54.37.234.136/voicemail. The scripts additionally spawn an infinite `for((i=1;;i++))` loop that repeatedly curls sequential paths at the same host every 10 seconds, providing a persistent install-time beacon/command-relay channel to an attacker-controlled bare-IP endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
